purpose: Define safe application of additive Contract Format 1.4 patch packages into a clean review tree, with explicit target identity, preconditions, post-validation and no silent overwrite of conflicting canonical semantics.

value.package_rule: Patch package contains an explicit manifest of added/changed/retired artifacts.
value.target_rule: Each patch operation targets exact canonical identity/source mapping.
value.precondition_rule: Patch may declare required predecessor package/snapshot/ref conditions.
value.conflict_rule: Existing conflicting semantic target hard-fails rather than being silently overwritten.
value.apply_rule: Patch application changes the candidate review tree only; it does not automatically activate/release/replace the accepted tree.
value.validation_rule: Affected format/reference/Topic/composition dimensions are revalidated after application.
value.ordering_rule: Patch dependency order is explicit; ZIP/file enumeration order is not semantic application order.
value.rollback_rule: Failed patch application leaves or restores a deterministic pre-application candidate state.
